role: non-RULER shared-context replication of the natural adaptive layer-quota contrast
prerequisites: terminal digest-bound nine-seed P2 causal audit
terminal Qwen3-4B adaptive-quota RULER audit regardless of outcome
terminal baseline Qwen3-4B SCBench audit regardless of outcome
verified frozen SCBench dataset, source, scorer, model, and fixed-baseline selection
execution_policy: run every frozen turn under both arms; prerequisite outcomes change interpretation and never select tasks, modes, rows, or turns

benchmark.name: SCBench
benchmark.paired_unit: the same frozen mode/task/row/turn with identical rendered segments and exact token ids

natural-adaptive-quota+pins.layer_signal: normalized entropy concentration of z-scored current-layer scorer values
natural-adaptive-quota+pins.causal_prior: running mean of earlier-layer concentrations only

scorer_selection.rule: reuse the frozen score-compatible Qwen selection without SCBench outcome inspection

cache_lifecycle_contract.post_prefill_turn_tokens: append identically to both arms without adaptive reallocation
cache_lifecycle_contract.multi_turn_answer_tokens: remove generated answers identically while retaining official golden follow-up prompts
cache_lifecycle_contract.multi_request_restore: restore the same arm-specific post-prefill cache after every independent query
per_successful_shared_context_audit: all 36 initial layer allocations in causal order
configured and observed initial total kept tokens
score concentration and controller time per layer
initial hot-resident bytes, peak HBM, and prefill latency

statistics.derived_seed_policy: overall uses the base seed; modes use base plus 1-based manifest index; mode-task cells use base plus 100 plus 1-based manifest Cartesian index
statistics.failure_policy: intention-to-evaluate; every operational or unsupported-context failure scores zero and is never dropped or silently retried

failure_reporting.paired_scoring_policy: retain every frozen turn and score allowed failures zero

claim_boundary: A passing result supports bounded transfer of the initial causal layer-quota heuristic from RULER to one Qwen3-4B SCBench shared-context cohort. It does not establish continuous adaptive reallocation after prefill, long-generation refresh, dynamic serving, cross-model transfer, the full natural suite, or official DeepSeek-V4 behavior.
